query: WITH columns AS (SELECT column_name || ':' || data_type AS item FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='user_progress' ORDER BY ordinal_position), policies AS (SELECT policyname || ':' || cmd AS item FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='user_progress' ORDER BY policyname), functions AS (SELECT proname AS item FROM pg_proc JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=pg_proc.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND proname IN ('can_track_lesson_for_current_student','record_lesson_view','complete_lesson_for_current_student','get_my_course_progress','get_admin_progress_overview') ORDER BY proname), constraints AS (SELECT conname || ':' || pg_get_constraintdef(oid) AS item FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.user_progress'::regclass AND conname IN ('user_progress_user_id_lesson_id_key','user_progress_status_check','user_progress_study_seconds_check') ORDER BY conname) SELECT 'column' AS audit_type,item FROM columns UNION ALL SELECT 'policy',item FROM policies UNION ALL SELECT 'function',item FROM functions UNION ALL SELECT 'constraint',item FROM constraints ORDER BY audit_type,item;
